execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a future MSLR tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries that tranche through implementation, required validation, verified closeout, and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, history, benchmark and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation, and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If the selected tranche cannot credibly leave the closeout reserve intact, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the tranche.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MSLR is the reusable non-standard spatial-law gameplay runtime; it does not become a second World, Reality, Scene, Map, Environment, Action/Event, Transition/Portal, Knowledge or Campaign-state ledger

completed SSA remains spatial semantic/topology authoring authority; MSLR consumes SSA nodes and relationships and adds executable law profiles and live spatial-law state without reopening SSA completion

MCS retains cartographic geometry, map/interior authoring and presentation authority; MSLR may request topology, confidence, layer, gravity-frame and contradiction projections but drawing does not create spatial truth

ENV retains environmental preset/overlay authority including Reality Instability, Dimensional Bleed, Portal Activity, Temporal Instability and Dream Influence; MSLR executes source/owner-authorized spatial consequences without making those overlays hidden causes

GPR retains generic gameplay-pattern execution, loop composition, replay and delivery-mode authority; MSLR specializes spatial-law semantics and composes GPR operations rather than becoming a competing general runtime

MBES retains built-environment, construction, infrastructure and settlement authority; MSLR can apply impossible-space laws to accepted sites, structures and spaces without becoming a second construction system

MSWI retains cross-domain systemic consequence propagation; MSLR exposes typed spatial observations, events and deltas for MSWI rather than directly inventing ecology, economy, faction or settlement consequences

PCA-02/PCA-03 retain generic procedural recipe/generator substrate and PCA-12 retains generic simulation/formal-analysis workbench; MSLR-14 implements only spatial-law recipes, model adapters, diagnostics and domain interpretation
PDCP Packet 07 shared preview/explanation/diagnostic/intervention/reversal semantics are reused; MSLR does not create a second generic GM/debug framework

geometry, topology, metric geometry, orientation, containment/scale, perception/knowledge, environment conditions and live campaign state remain distinct dimensions even when one spatial-law profile composes several
non-euclidean topology does not imply non-euclidean metric geometry; metric profiles explicitly own distance/range/area/line-of-sight transforms where enabled
Dimensional Bleed, fuzzy boundaries and portal traversal remain distinct; bleed intensity never grants traversability without Transition/Portal/Access authority
true topology, observable topology, participant-known topology and player-authored/suspected topology remain separate and permission-filtered

observer-, memory-, knowledge- or perception-dependent spatial laws may change route availability only through explicit governed predicates and events; no client-side observation silently rewrites canonical topology
dynamic topology changes are event-traced, deterministic where the selected profile declares determinism, recoverable, versioned and attributable to an authorized source

procedural impossible-space generation is constraint-driven and must prove required reachability/solvability properties before promotion; generation is ephemeral/proposed until GM or owner-authorized acceptance
abstract navigation checks remain a valid resolution mode but cannot be the only supported interaction model for authored spatial-law gameplay

consequential anomalies expose accessible nonvisual equivalents; no puzzle may require color, vision, hearing, precision dragging or motion as the sole information channel when an equivalent semantic cue can be provided
optional AI may suggest law profiles, hypotheses, diagnostics, maps or tests but cannot reveal protected topology, accept generated space, change spatial truth or commit traversal outcomes
clean-room benchmark research informs generalized capabilities only; protected code, assets, maps, level layouts, UI expression, formulas, music, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking MSLR workflows
no MSLR implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific surviving MSLR work item
